description: Combine selected code/proxy observations, contract-reported token facts and one wallet's ETH/Transfer evidence at one provider-finalized Base block. State and logs are selected by block hash, with evidence pointers and a canonical header recheck. At most 18 reads. Wallet history and contract safety are outside the evidence scope. One fixed workflow charge; internal steps never create separate customer charges. Each call selects one finalized Base block. Reuse its contract_snapshot_id only as previous_contract_snapshot for compatible contract comparison; this workflow accepts no observation_id. Auth: authorized native-USDC x402 v2 on Base, enabled MPP, or an eligible prepaid key plus exact tariff 5 and max_credits. Ordinary unpaid calls return a challenge, not execution. Persist original input, proof and recovery token before submission; exact replay returns retained results without fresh work or another charge. Choose evidence detail before authorization. No free-trial or automatic paid fallback. 0.025 USDC or 10 credits. Limits and scope are authoritative, not a complete audit or compatibility guarantee. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; Standalone native Solana MPP solana/charge is also advertised; its client pays a separately authorized SOL network fee, with no server fee sponsorship. Prepaid MPP funding remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.
